intermediates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Miremoon Crownmaw battle animation sprite sheet using this original creature reference. Preserve squat massive gray reptilian body, root-heavy clawed limbs, layered blue glowing peatglass scutes with crescent markings, moss and hanging beard, ivory tusks, enormous crescent-shaped antler crown, blue eyes, and thick tapered armored tail. Exactly TWELVE complete poses in FOUR columns by THREE rows. Every creature faces RIGHT, same elevated three-quarter tactical camera and same body size, generous empty gutters, full tail/antlers/claws inside each cell. Row1: idle low stance; chest breathing shoulders lifted slightly; walking contact A near foreclaw forward and opposite rear foot forward; walking contact B near foreclaw back and near rear foot forward. Row2: passing heavy step foreclaw lifted under shoulder; attack windup jaws opening head drawn back; forward crown-jaw BITE lunge, neck extended right and foreclaws braced, jaw closing; defensive low brace all limbs planted and antler crown protecting face. Row3: impact recoil shoulders back head twisted away; dying front knees buckling crown lowering; falling onto SIDE legs folded and jaw slack; final DEAD body flat on side with head/antlers resting on ground, limp claws/tail, eyes closed and blue markings dim. No blood. Actual redrawn articulation and weight shift, not repeated standing cutouts or rotation/scale tricks. Detailed painterly original raster style matching reference. Genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard, colored matte, scenery, ground, cast shadow, particles, fog, text, labels, grid or panel borders.
intermediates.status: Original articulated source; RGB checkerboard not runtime alpha

review_notes: Twelve original heavy-step, crown-jaw bite, brace, recoil and collapsed dead poses packed. Real RGBA 0..255. Candidate only; gait contacts and continuous motion require refinement/review.
